correctness.rationale: The exact 3×3 fiber Fourier matrix gives D_m(τ)=64sin²πτ sin²πmτ sin²π(m+1)τ. AM–GM applied to squared chord lengths gives D≤27 with equality only at τ=1/3,2/3 and m≡1 (mod 3). A direct trial c=±1/3 gives 27−6π²/m²+O(m^-3); uniform equilateral phase expansion and discrete alias quantization globally rule out other limits and give the matching upper bound. Strict negative second derivative of log D within nonzero cells gives eventual unique reflected optimizer pair with τ=1/3+σ/[3(m+1/2)]+O(m^-3). The standalone checker executed 4,274 finite assertions successfully, as corroboration only. No infinite assertion rests solely on these finite tests.
